conclusion: No blocking source flaw identified for supplied synthetic CPU engineering checks. One scoped CUDA checkpoint/RNG defect requires repair or explicit device rejection before claiming CUDA replay support.

findings.action: Create a preserved successor that normalizes the device, resolves an unindexed CUDA device to the selected current index, and uses that resolved device consistently for seeding/capture/restore. Alternatively reject the unindexed CUDA spelling explicitly before numerical use.
findings.evidence: rng_state, restore_rng and the explicit CUDA seed branch use str(device).startswith("cuda:"). An unindexed CUDA spelling fails that predicate while model and tensors can still run on CUDA.
findings.impact: Snapshots store cuda=None and restoration skips the live CUDA stream; next-update dropout replay cannot be guaranteed. This is a blocker for the claimed CUDA state/replay invariant under that input, and has no effect on the supplied CPU synthetic checks.
findings.title: Unindexed CUDA devices omit the CUDA RNG stream
findings.trigger: An admitted caller supplies device="cuda" or torch.device("cuda"), both accepted by PyTorch device transfers.
findings.verification_needed: A source or stub check must demonstrate that accepted unindexed CUDA input resolves consistently, or is rejected clearly. Numerical CUDA replay remains a separate admitted check.

inspected_invariants.assessment: Each untied family deep-copies the initialized tied core and boundary W, retains the corresponding one-row R/S/B, and delegates to the unchanged bound v6 forward_member. No new constructor/reset or explicit RNG draw occurs in untie; numerical storage/function equality remains runtime evidence.

The plan is native members 0..3 then assigned-view members 0..3; each TRAIN mean CE/4 backpropagates immediately; zero_grad occurs once and Adam steps once after all eight passes. Thus the declared sum of four [native CE + probe CE]/4 is implemented with pre-step parameters. Active and dormant gradient checks match stage use; FP32 summation equivalence requires numerical comparison.

One strict correct-count selector spans actual updates 1..2700 and preserves earliest ties. At actual 200, only selected-local model/Adam are restored, the live RNG is explicitly restored, and the clock remains 200 before global update 201. Final restoration reapplies stage flags, per-module modes, model/Adam, gradients and RNG, including a local final winner. The CUDA device spelling finding limits the RNG claim.

Declared dependency paths are phase-relative; verify_descriptor resolves from ROOT.parent, verifies bytes and hashes, and runtime compiles the reverified neural bytes. Actual resolved neural paths are recorded. All 13 payload descriptors, 10 bound descriptors and 8 exact line excerpts matched in this inspection.

Semantic categories use unordered non-loop TRAIN-TRAIN pairs only; floor10% is sampled separately by class equality/difference. Filtering removes both directions, preserves surviving native order and retains every loop. Null pools ignore class values during sampling and match the requested native endpoint degree-bin stratum counts; undersupply and empty masks prohibit freeze eligibility. Semantic/null overlap is allowed and measured for each matched mask.

TrainRole admits every TRAIN label and only role IDs for VAL/TEST. Training consumes only TRAIN labels; separate VAL labels enter the pooled native selector and selected reporting. Final prediction is the mean of four class-softmax probability vectors; pooled NLL uses stable log-mean probabilities. There is no TEST label reader.

limitations: Source inspection does not establish numerical correctness; this reviewer did not execute either supplied test suite or inspect a numerical receipt.

Reduced synthetic numerical fixtures do not establish full Amazon shape behavior, resource usage, library/backend compatibility or CUDA determinism. Final raw-logit equality requires a backend that reproduces evaluation exactly; runtime does not itself enforce deterministic algorithms.

Official masks, compact-label projection and acquisition provenance remain the admitted caller responsibility. Shape/count/digest checks establish consistency and identity, and do not independently prove official data origin.

verify_bundle checks live bundle custody against supplied coverage; it does not independently reconstruct view semantics. The intended trusted construction path is prepare_views/construct_views followed by saved coverage and an external source/protocol freeze.
The checkpoint API stores a complete selected model/Adam/RNG/function image, but the driver has no mid-run restart orchestration for clock/selector/trace continuation; this limitation is disclosed.
Real fixed-mask/null-stratum coverage and an external scientific freeze are absent. Coarse null matching does not match exact per-node degree loss or prove useful semantic probe strength.

Modern single/conventional independent controls, paired synthesis, worthwhile-gain rule and confirmation/TEST-history protocol are unimplemented. Their absence prohibits a final quality claim and does not prohibit synthetic CPU engineering checks.
VAL is reused for checkpoint selection and exploratory assessment; reported VAL metrics provide no independent heldout confirmation.
scope: Source correctness review; no package execution, numerical imports, servers, real data, scientific outcomes, source edits, PDF compilation, or acceptance certification.
